verdict.rationale: Mem0's webhooks fire real-time notifications (HTTP POST) when memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized, which lets an external system react to memory events — a basic building block for event-driven automation. However, there is no evidence of a native rules engine where users define conditions/logic that trigger actions automatically inside Mem0 itself; webhooks only forward raw events to an external URL, requiring the automation logic to live outside the product. Missing for 10: a documented rules/condition engine, in-app action definitions, and any independent corroboration of automation workflows beyond simple webhook notifications.
